statements.text: TaskItem carries an integer version, serialized in JSON as `version`.
POST /tasks returns 201 with a task whose `version` = 1.
UpdateTaskRequest accepts an optional integer `expectedVersion` (absent/null is legal).
Every successful PUT /tasks/{id} increments the task's `version` by exactly 1.
PUT /tasks/{id} with an `expectedVersion` that does not equal the task's current `version` is rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict.
A 409-rejected PUT leaves the stored task completely unchanged: no field updated and no version bump.
PUT /tasks/{id} with an `expectedVersion` equal to the current `version` succeeds with 200 and increments `version`.
PUT /tasks/{id} with `expectedVersion` omitted proceeds unconditionally (last-writer-wins) with 200 and increments `version`.
PUT /tasks/{id} for an unknown id returns 404 whether or not `expectedVersion` is supplied.
dotnet build and dotnet test stay green, including the pre-existing PUT test that omits `expectedVersion`.
GET /tasks, GET /tasks/{id} and DELETE /tasks/{id} keep their existing behaviour; changes stay inside src/TaskTracker.Api and tests/TaskTracker.Tests.
